taurida-2016.notes: Our copy is headed NEERC Northern Subregional Contest, St Petersburg, 22 October 2016, not Taurida; its eleven problems match the catalogue's list of problems for taurida-2016 and the date agrees, so it is kept as confirm with medium confidence. A human should decide whether the Taurida contest used this set.

sources.evidence: The PDF has eleven problems A to K whose titles are those the catalogue lists for this contest and carries the same date, 22 October 2016, but every page is headed with the Northern Subregional Contest, St Petersburg, and Taurida is not mentioned.
